sections.name: 阅读理解
sections.note: 每题 2 分。阅读所给文章，从四个选项中选出最佳答案。

passage.title: Wellness programmes at work
passage.text: Company wellness programmes usually offer gym discounts, fruit in the kitchen and an app that counts steps. Reviews of their effects are mixed. Participation is highest among employees who are already healthy, and the measured improvements are small. Meanwhile the strongest influence on employee health is rarely mentioned: how work is organised. Long and unpredictable hours, low control over tasks and unclear expectations produce stress that no step counter can offset. A few employers have redirected the budget from apps to scheduling, giving teams notice of shifts and a voice in how work is divided. Reported stress fell further than in any of the fitness schemes.

sections.name: 写作
sections.note: 本题 12 分。按题目要求写一篇短文。

items.stem: Write an essay of about 150 words on the following topic: many companies offer wellness programmes. Do they address the real causes of workplace stress?

answer.text: Wellness programmes are popular because they are visible and inexpensive. A gym discount and a step counter signal that the company cares, yet the evidence suggests they reach the wrong people: participation is highest among employees who are already fit, and the measured gains are small. The main sources of stress lie elsewhere, in long and unpredictable hours, low control over tasks and unclear expectations. No app offsets a schedule that changes without notice. The more effective investment is therefore organisational: publish shifts in advance, let teams influence how work is divided, and make priorities explicit. Health programmes can supplement such changes, but they cannot substitute for them.

explain.right: 先定三段骨架（描述—分析—结论），再把题目给出的信息逐条落进段落，最后检查字数与衔接词。
explain.wrong: 常见错误：把健康项目说成完全无用，或只呼吁「员工多运动」，回避工作组织方式这一成因。
